name: Montgomery County, TX
findings: Montgomery County has 1,561 nonprofit organizations. 641 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 486 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 12 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 32 would.

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few political organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 political organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Montgomery County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 138 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 138 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
